sources.title: Hybrid Contrastive Learning for Unsupervised Person Re-Identification
sources.snippet: In this paper, we propose a novel Hybrid Contrastive Model (HCM) to perform the identity-level contrastive learning and the image-level contrastive learning for unsupervised person Re-ID, which adequately explores feature similarities among hard sample pairs.
